criteria: Inspect actual pinned canon whole, July head only and era finish references before reading producer claims. Compare matched1280-long-edge12-sample neutral and workshop wholes, then relevant regions, opposite profile, rear and eight-angle continuity.

Judge net source resemblance at whole size. Reject improvements confined to a close-up when crown/bill/orbit, body, toes, stance or rear costs outweigh them. Describe which gains are small and which dominate the remaining silhouette.

Verify three native successors against exact retained02:7644 incoming mesh/empty payloads,62 original graphs,161 Advanced or160 Maker/Mechanic packed FILE images; original geometry/transforms/UVs/slots/face indices and rig/world/anchors unchanged except exact selected hides. 45 added meshes; no new head materials. Added geometry must be intentional and finite.

Verify all69 candidate view camera/light/resolution/sample metadata against the retained Loop01 baselines. Verify three actual static embedded GLBs and joint material-indexed oriented triangle-corner position/UV correspondence; decode actual embedded image pixels and preserve encoded-map comparisons. Record strict-normal failures at unchanged threshold separately, including whether inherited or newly introduced; cause unknown and strict normal pass is not claimed. Counts and material names alone are insufficient.

Inspect actual browser evidence for all three eras, both lights, manual PNG fallback and reset. Native/browser lighting differs, so no pixel or complete shader parity is implied. Report interaction/performance/mobile/new-host/forced-failure checks only if actually run.

Production app/runtime, original09 histories, source imagery and private archives remain preserved. Existing local build evidence has bounded scope; no CI/deployment, animation, engineering or owner acceptance claim.
Recommend approve-with-limits, reject or smallest additional necessary evidence. Retention is a development decision; full source twin and owner likeness acceptance remain separate.

independence_limits: Separate reused evidence, outcome and safety QA contexts with shared Sol model family, source set and Blender semantics. Shared context/model correlation remains.
Each QA makes its first actual source/whole judgment before producer claims; no reading other current QA reports.
All source images and video frames are development-seen; no protected holdout.
Source camera/depth and manually traced 2D correspondences are estimated, not calibrated reconstruction.
equilibrium_route: Three initial independent reviewers. Material agreement permits a narrow falsifiable disruptor and then negotiation. Material disagreement goes directly to root negotiation; no ceremonial disruption.
expiry: Any changed source/native/GLB/render/module/browser/criteria bytes require a new scoped review. Dynamic budget, control and post-freeze remote receipts are outside the freeze.
